meta.name: understand-knowledge
meta.description: Analyze a Karpathy-pattern LLM wiki knowledge base and generate an interactive knowledge graph with entity extraction, implicit relationships, and topic clustering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将LLM知识库转化为交互式知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从大量文本中提取实体和关系并可视化
copy.tagline_en: Transform LLM knowledge base into interactive knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract entities and relationships from large text and visualize them

howto.what: 分析 Karpathy 模式的 LLM wiki 知识库(原始资料、wiki markdown、schema 三层),抽取实体、隐式关系和主题聚类,生成交互式知识图谱并自动打开面板。
howto.when: 当你提供 wiki 目录路径,或当前目录符合 Karpathy wiki 特征(存在 index.md 和含 wikilinks 的多个 .md 文件)时接管。

say.note: 扫描该目录并生成知识图谱

say.text: 分析这个知识库,画出知识图谱
say.note: 不传路径时用当前工作目录

say.text: 这个 wiki 有哪些主题和未解析链接?
say.note: 会先输出检测到的条目统计

howto.what_en: Analyzes a Karpathy-pattern LLM wiki (raw sources, wiki markdown, schema) and produces an interactive knowledge graph with extracted entities, implicit relationships, and topic clustering, then auto-opens the dashboard.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you pass a wiki directory path, or when the current directory looks like a Karpathy wiki (an index.md plus multiple .md files with wikilinks).

say_en.note: Scans that folder and builds the graph.

say_en.text: Analyze this knowledge base and draw a graph
say_en.note: Uses the current working directory if no path is given.

say_en.text: What topics and unresolved links are in this wiki?
